errors.evidence: This misrepresents the initial trends. The 5-digit line has a much steeper initial increase between iteration 0 and 1 (from ~2% to ~67%) than the 6-digit line (from ~2% to ~38%).
The description omits mentioning the intersection of the two lines around iteration 3, which is a key comparative feature of the plot.
The description does not mention the presence of a legend in the top-left corner, which is used to identify the two data series.
